Export the inputs and all calculations to one Excel workbook with live formulas

Source: R/fct_make_XL.R
fct_make_XL.Rd

Writes a single XLSX file where the calculation chain of mocaredd is reproduced as Excel formulas, so every result can be traced back to the input cells and recalculated in Excel when an input changes. The workbook contains:

  • the input tabs (setup, time, area, carbon, or the v1 equivalents) and any other tab of the input file, unchanged;

  • Calc EF: carbon elements aggregated into carbon stocks per land use, then into emission factors per land use transition, with value, standard error (SE) and uncertainty (U\

  • Calc ERRs: activity data and emission factors aggregated into emissions per transition, per time period (and REDD+ activity), reference and monitoring levels, and emission reductions, with value, SE and U\

  • Calc MCS: one row per source of simulations, in blocks (AD, carbon elements, carbon stocks and EF, E_REF / E_MON / ER_MON), with the input or Approach 1 result (value, SE, U\ median, confidence interval and U\

  • Calc Formulas: every formula used, one per row, with a short description;

  • Sims: the Monte Carlo simulations used by Calc MCS (one column per row of Calc MCS), written as values.

The Approach 1 formulas follow fct_arithmetic_mean3(), so after recalculation the workbook gives the same carbon stocks, emission factors, emissions and emission reductions. Simulations are random draws and are written as values: the simulation statistics in Calc MCS are formulas on the Sims tab, but they do not change when an input changes.

U\ \(z\) the two-sided normal quantile for setup$conf_level. The simulation U\ fct_calc_res().

Formulas are written without cached results. Excel and LibreOffice calculate them when the file is opened, but tools that read cached values (e.g. readxl) see empty cells until the file has been opened and saved.

Usage

fct_make_XL(
  .checked_data,
  .mcs = NULL,
  .path_in = NULL,
  .path_out,
  .sims_sheet = TRUE
)

Arguments

.checked_data

The list returned by fct_checkinput().

.mcs

Optional list of simulations, as rv$mcs in the app: sim_trans (output of fct_combine_mcs_E()) and, optionally, sim_REF, sim_MON (fct_combine_mcs_P()) and sim_ER (fct_combine_mcs_ER()). Missing period level simulations are calculated from sim_trans. If NULL, the simulation columns of Calc MCS are left empty.

.path_in

Path to the input XLSX file that was checked. All its tabs are copied and the calculation tabs refer to its cells. If NULL, the four tables of .checked_data are written instead.

.path_out

Path of the XLSX file to write.

.sims_sheet

If TRUE (default), simulations are written to the Sims tab and their statistics are Excel formulas. If FALSE, the statistics are written as values and the Sims tab is omitted (smaller file).

Value

The path of the XLSX file, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
path    <- system.file("extdata/mocaredd-templatev2-simple.xlsx", package = "mocaredd")
checked <- fct_checkinput(.path = path)

set.seed(checked$data$setup$ran_seed)
sim_trans <- fct_combine_mcs_E(.checked_data = checked)

fct_make_XL(
  .checked_data = checked,
  .mcs          = list(sim_trans = sim_trans),
  .path_in      = path,
  .path_out     = tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
)
} # }
